copy.text: How to find someone's accounts after they die

scenes.why: The hook is the guide's own title: the question it answers, as a person would put it.

copy.text: Regular outgoings point to insurance, subscriptions and loan payments you didn't know existed.
Regular incomings point to pensions, annuities and rental income.
Annual payments are easy to miss in three months of statements and obvious across twelve.

scenes.why: The guide's own checklist, the first sentence of each item, ticked in as it is read.

scenes.why: The turn: the product the guide itself hands over to, named and shown on its real screen, captioned with its listing's line closest to what the guide teaches. Screen: "Write down who should be called first." reasoning.because: Transitions follow the product's own identity motif, "book": a handoff book, so scenes turn like pages.
